'''Bibliotron Systems''' was a droid design company based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], owned by [[Alferon Choots Bemming]]. Among the droids produced by Bibliotron was the [[Librarian droid/Legends|library droid]] [[P-RC3]].
